Summary: Leviticus 19:4 forbids even turning toward idols: 'Turn ye not unto idols, nor make to yourselves molten gods: I am the LORD your God.' The sin begins before the idol is made, in the turning of attention and trust.
Commandment: Do not turn to idols, nor make molten gods for yourselves.
Application: Idolatry starts with a glance, not a statue. Guarding the turn of heart and eye is the first defence of exclusive worship.
Purpose: Scripture's stated seal: I am the LORD your God (Leviticus 19:4).
